query: What signals suggest a goal will be highly achieved?

per_column.name: intervention_type
per_column.rationale: The kind of intervention (process improvement, automation, training, etc.) is a characteristic of the goal knowable in advance and plausibly correlates with achievement likelihood; it does not restate the outcome.

per_column.name: action_mechanism
per_column.rationale: The concrete mechanism used to pursue the goal is an ex-ante attribute that could differentiate success rates; valid external predictor.

per_column.name: technology_enablement
per_column.rationale: Whether technology enables the goal is a design/context feature independent of the achievement outcome and may carry signal.

per_column.name: baseline_stated
per_column.rationale: Whether a baseline is explicitly stated reflects goal-setting quality, knowable up front, and plausibly relates to achievement without restating it.

per_column.name: improvement_target_pct_range
per_column.rationale: The ambitiousness of the target range is a property of the goal itself, set before the outcome; harder targets may be less achieved. It is derived from target_percentage (already in original columns) so its marginal leverage is limited, but it is not leakage of the achievement outcome.

per_column.name: timeline_granularity
per_column.rationale: Timeframe structure (annual, quarterly, no timeline) is an ex-ante planning attribute plausibly linked to achievement; does not restate outcome.

per_column.name: action_specificity
per_column.rationale: How specific/multi-pronged the planned actions are is a knowable-in-advance quality attribute that can carry predictive signal about goal achievement.

per_column.name: metric_alignment
per_column.rationale: Whether the metric aligns with the goal is a goal-design property independent of the realized outcome and plausibly predictive of success.

per_column.name: comparative_reference_type
per_column.rationale: The type of comparative baseline referenced is an ex-ante framing attribute; not a restatement of achievement and may relate to goal clarity/success.

judge.rationale: All added columns are ex-ante, goal-design and intervention attributes that lie outside the focus variable and contain no outcome leakage or restatement of high_goal_achievement. They plausibly encode goal quality (baseline stated, metric alignment, action specificity), ambition (target range), and intervention approach, which are reasonable predictors. However, several are somewhat generic/redundant with existing columns (improvement_target_pct_range largely mirrors target_percentage; timeline_granularity overlaps with start/end dates), and none captures execution progress or resource signals, so the incremental predictive leverage as a set is moderate rather than strong.
